About

A young man on a journey to greatness, curious by nature and not too focused on any one thing.

This is the digital space where the story of a young man on a journey to greatness lies. I am, by nature, a curious person and I love to learn new things and pick up new skills along the way as I continue this journey of mine. I believe a person should not be too focused on one thing in life as we only live once, and that thing should not become their entire personality.

I am a VFX/CGI and video editing artist, graphic designer and photo editor. I am an engineering student, and I also love nature and wildlife. I find joy and ecstasy when sketching on my tablet, playing chess and when cycling along the road with my friends, triggering adrenaline at its highest level with the thrills.

Growing up in Limpopo, between villages and suburbs, shaped my grounded outlook on life, my love for open landscapes, and my appreciation for community. Today I carry those roots with me as I explore everything from visual arts and engineering to coastal cycling and hands-on building.

Outside of any classroom or lab, I am someone who thrives on variety and adapts to surroundings quickly. Whether I am sketching characters on my graphics tablet at night, sharing a weekend braai and a game of chess with close friends, or spotting wildlife in a nature reserve, I believe in living a well-rounded, curious, and authentic life.

“A jack of all trades and a master of none is oftentimes better than a master of one.”Prince Rams

Projects

A blend of mobile app development, 2D and 3D visual art, and hands-on electronic prototyping.

Android Studio app

Terrorbit: live and interactive wallpaper engine

A custom Android Studio mobile application built to organize and apply still artwork, seamless live video loops, and interactive HTML/JS wallpapers on mobile devices. Built with a little bit of Java, and a lot of assistance from the Google Argon model with XMLs and frameworks.

Android Studio, HTML/CSS/JS, UI/Java

Wildfire Arts

2D and 3D art workflows

Original digital illustrations, intricate SVG vector paths, and 3D graphics of my Terrorbit app logo crafted across Adobe Illustrator and Blender 3D.

Adobe Illustrator, Blender

Hardware and EV

Water Level Detector System in loadshedding conditions

A capstone project to build a water level detector system that satisfies six given cases and responds accordingly. With the use of logic gates in 8-pin ICs and 555 timer ICs, and analog components such as resistors, buzzer, LEDs, capacitors and wires.

Circuits, sensors, logic
